preparation_amendment: Before any target analyses or builder access, supersede v1 preparation because pandas 3.0.3 XPORT reader decoded 325 true zero fasting weights as 5.397605346934028e-79. ReadStat 1.3.7 correctly decodes 2711 positive and 325 zero weights, matching official documentation. Statistical analysis plan unchanged.
purpose: Exploratory evidence-guided virtual-column analytical utility; no exact individual recovery claim.

selection_before_outcome_analysis.target: LBXTR reference-method fasting serum triglycerides, mg/dL
selection_before_outcome_analysis.domain: RIDAGEYR 20 through 79 inclusive; RIAGENDR in 1,2; finite positive BMXBMI and LBXTR; finite positive WTSAF2YR; nonmissing SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU; MEC examined RIDSTATR=2
selection_before_outcome_analysis.age_rationale: Exclude topcoded age 80+ so age association has an unambiguous year scale.
selection_before_outcome_analysis.fasting: Use WTSAF2YR>0. TRIGLY_J documentation assigns zero to participants not meeting 8 to <24 hour fasting or without qualifying lab specimen. No inclusion/reweighting of zero-weight records.
selection_before_outcome_analysis.missingness: Complete cases form a prespecified analysis domain. No outcome imputation, item-nonresponse reweighting, outlier removal, winsorization, or data-selected transformation. Inference does not establish representativeness after item nonresponse.
selection_before_outcome_analysis.survey_universe: All linked records with WTSAF2YR>0 and valid design variables remain in the variance-design table, including observations outside the complete-case adult domain. Their estimating-function contributions are zero.

visible.id: Opaque random-order IDs; SEQN mapping stays custodial
visible.output: Append finite positive tg_mg_dl; preserve all input cells and row order

transforms.outcome: natural logarithm of TG in mg/dL
transforms.rationale: A priori multiplicative concentration/ratio estimand. No outcome distribution inspection used to choose transformation.

endpoints.meaning: TG geometric-mean ratio per 5 kg/m^2 higher BMI, adjusted for age and sex
TG ratio per 10 years, adjusted for BMI and sex
Female/male TG ratio, adjusted for BMI and age
log(TG at BMI35)-2*log(TG at BMI30)+log(TG at BMI25), age/sex held constant
Female minus male log-TG slope per 5 kg/m^2; exponentiation is a ratio of BMI ratios

estimation.point: Weighted least squares using WTSAF2YR (normalized by its domain mean for numerical stability; invariant to global weight rescaling)
estimation.variance: With-replacement first-stage Taylor linearization. H=sum_domain(w*x*x'); score_i=domain_i*w_i*x_i*(y_i-x_i'b); u_hj=sum_i_in_PSU(score_i). Meat=sum_h m_h/(m_h-1)*sum_j (u_hj-mean_j(u_hj))*(u_hj-mean_j(u_hj))'. V=H^-1 Meat H^-1. Include every positive-weight design PSU, even with zero domain score; no finite population correction.
estimation.interval: Two-sided 95% t interval with df equal to represented-domain PSUs minus represented-domain strata; report df and full design support. No parameter-count subtraction; this is an explicit NHANES nominal design-df convention.
estimation.singleton: If a full-design stratum has fewer than two PSUs or domain design df<=0, stop and report non-estimable; no automatic lonely-PSU fix.
estimation.implementation: Python NumPy/pandas/SciPy custom implementation; validate against analytic invented fixtures, WLS point estimate, weight rescaling and PSD covariance. R not found in PATH or standard installation locations; no claim of R survey cross-validation.

comparison.gate: No evaluation until root confirms every initial/final generated target table is committed and its hashes are recorded. Custodian evaluates all committed outputs using identical frozen models, domain, rows, weights and survey design.
comparison.report: Reference and each generated endpoint: log-scale coefficient, SE, 95% interval, exp-scale ratio interval and direction category (positive, negative, or interval includes zero). Report signed difference and absolute log-scale error, initial-to-final changes for matched seeds, and summaries across seeds.
comparison.limits: Same-person generated and reference estimates are dependent; do not use independent-sample difference intervals. No scientific pass threshold is chosen. No equivalence or absence-of-association claim follows from nonsignificance. CI overlap or a generated point falling inside a reference CI is descriptive, not a calibrated coverage/equivalence test. Secondary intervals are unadjusted exploratory intervals. Draw variation is simulation sensitivity, not source/model/transport uncertainty. No post-evaluation builder revision.

boundary.release: Only observed.csv, task_metadata.json, README.md, preparation_counts.json, and visible input hashes may be shared before commitment; protocol may be inspected by controller without outcomes.
